'''Mount Redolava''', also known as the '''Big Rock''', was a mountain on the [[planet]] [[Vandor]] that had an elevation of 2,990 [[meter]]s.<ref name="Official Guide" /> One of [[Tivoche Bilure]]'s jobs involved climbing the Big Rock to help set up a [[comm repeater]].<ref name="Tales from Vandor">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story: Tales from Vandor]]''</ref>
